arguments.value: This agreement appoints S2K Financial to market and introduce certain real estate funds to broker-dealers and other financial intermediaries, while ALPS Distributors handles selling agreements, reviews marketing materials, and makes required regulatory filings. S2K must use reasonable efforts to promote the funds, follow applicable securities rules, and stay properly registered, but cannot act as an underwriter or open customer accounts. The distributor pays S2K compensation from the funds' sales charges or dealer reallowance fees, subject to prospectus terms and FINRA/law limits, and S2K reimburses certain expenses such as FINRA filing fees. Both sides make standard legal and regulatory promises, agree to indemnify each other for violations or misstatements they cause, and keep each other’s confidential information protected. The agreement also says S2K is an independent contractor, limits use of each other’s names without consent, and is governed by Colorado law with disputes heard in Denver. It can be terminated on 60 days’ notice or when the related distribution agreement ends.
